newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares rise, Solidere mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares rise, Solidere mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares rose and Solidere were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday as Banque Audi shares rose to $17.125 from $17 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce went up to $12.5 from $12.25.
Solidere A shares fell to $10.5 from $10.625 on Friday and B shares rose to $11 from $10.875.
Turnover in Audi was 35,785 shares from Friday's 23,195 shares. Monday's deals included a block trade of 15,000 Audi shares traded inside the bourse floor at $17.125.
A total of 31,500 BLC shares were traded on Monday against 26,500 on Friday.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 151,887 shares for a value of $1,907,289 against 111,821 shares for $1,261,67 on Friday.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.09 percent to 912.53 and the LISPI stock index rose 0.27 percent to 81.62.

"The LISPI moved up 0.27 percent to 81.62 as the price of Solidere B shares increased to $11 and Audi and BLC shares increased to $17.125 and $12.5 respectively. Solidere A shares decreased to $10.5," Lebanon Invest Research Company, which compiles the index, said in its daily bulletin.
